# ubiops_organization_user (Resource)

Manages a user in a UbiOps organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ubiops_organization_user" "example" {
  organization_name = "my-organization"
  email             = "user@example.com"
  admin             = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email of the user
- `organization_name` (String) The name of the organization.

### Optional

- `admin` (Boolean) Boolean value indicating whether the user is an admin of the organization or not

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the user (UUID)
- `status` (String) The status of the user.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ubiops_organization_user.example my-organization/user-uuid
```
